description: Read the current property values of one or more nodes from a scene file, in one Godot process. Always-array: pass a one-element nodes array for one node. Per-node changedOnly: true leaves out properties that match the class defaults. Returns: results[] in input order: { nodePath, nodeType, properties }, or { nodePath, error } when not found. Values use the input shapes of set_node_properties. warnings leads when changedOnly had no defaults to compare. Errors if the scene cannot be loaded.

changedOnly.description: Only return properties differing from defaults (default: false)

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory

scenePath.description: Scene file path relative to the project

name: get_node_properties
